strings.JNR_KEYWORD_SIXTHSENSE: <style=cKeywordName>Sixth Sense</style><style=cSub>If you would take a lethal attack, instead <style=cIsUtility>dodge</style>, <style=cIsUtility>cleansing debuffs</style> and becoming <style=cIsUtility>invincible</style> for 3 seconds.</style>
strings.JNR_KEYWORD_IMPLACABLE: <style=cKeywordName>Implacable</style><style=cSub><style=cIsUtility>Immovable</style>, and damage taken is limited to <style=cIsHealing>20% of your max health</style> until you lose this effect</style>
strings.JNR_KEYWORD_FROSTTOUCH: <style=cKeywordName>Frost-Touch</style><style=cSub>While frost-touched, your greatsword applies <style=cIsUtility>frost</style> on hit, and charged attacks release blasts of moonlight for <style=cIsDamage>250% damage</style>.</style>
strings.JNR_KEYWORD_IGNITION: <style=cKeywordName>Ignition</style><style=cSub>While ignited, your greatsword hits deal an extra <style=cIsDamage>150% base damage.</style>
